notes:

The owner's order DAM-26791_1-1 (and QRT-262574_2-1: «Children Size», front length 80 cm, jabzour length 26 cm) was
stopped: «الجبزور الصغير (part 024): 143 mm long, in the design 420 mm». Every piece of a child's thobe is a third to
a half of the adult design's; the limit (half to twice the design's) was measured on adults.
- pattern_check.order_scale: the median of the order's pieces' length / width ratios to the design (4 pieces at
  least); each piece is compared with the design times that scale. One wrong measurement still makes one piece far
  from the others (stopped); an order all more than 3 times smaller / larger than the design (a unit typed wrong) is
  judged as before.
